description:
## What

`OctoPi.Coder.SessionStore` GenServer takes ownership of the `SessionManager` struct (by_id, file_entries, leaf_id, label index, id minting). Exposes a synchronous API:

- `append_entry/2` — mints id, links parent, persists, returns `{:ok, %Entry{...}}`
- `get_entry/2`
- `get_branch/1,2`
- `find_common_ancestor/3`
- `collect_entries_for_branch_summary/3`
- `build_session_context/2`

`OctoPi.Coder.Loop.State` drops `:session_manager`. Gains:

- `:path` — `[Entry.t()]` in root→leaf order, the current linearized path
- `:session_id`, `:session_file`, `:cwd` — metadata previously held inside SessionManager

Loop maintains `:path` as a local cache: prepends/appends on `Store.append_entry/2` mutation, refetches from store on branch-switch / post-compact reset (the latter handled in opi-1.3).

## Why

Today `Coder.Loop` carries the full tree (by_id + every branch); the store carries only a file handle. After this ticket the store is the source of truth for the tree, and Loop's state describes only "what is the conversation right now."

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_store.ex` — gains state
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_manager.ex` — survives as a pure-functions module the store delegates to (or is folded in; pick what reads better)
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex` — `State` slimmed; all `SessionManager.*` calls re-routed through `SessionStore` API
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/compaction/preparation.ex` — input source unchanged (still `path_entries` list); upstream caller in Loop now passes `state.path` instead of `SessionManager.get_branch(sm)`

## Out of scope

- `path/2` primitive with `:to` opts — opi-1.2.
- Compaction's path-reset unification — opi-1.3.
- `to_llm/1` consistency — opi-1.4.

## Done when

- `Coder.Loop.State` has no `:session_manager` field.
- `SessionStore` holds the `by_id`, `file_entries`, `leaf_id` it currently doesn't.
- All existing tests pass without modifying their assertions about JSONL byte-output.
- Round-trip a non-trivial pi-mono-generated session file: load → append a synthetic entry → bytes match what upstream would produce.
title: Move tree-of-record into SessionStore; Coder.Loop carries :path
